name: Modal Interchange vs Modulation & Relative vs Parallel Keys:
use_when: Chọn gam / scale để ngẫu hứng jazz
avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: Modal Interchange vs Modulation & Relative vs Parallel Keys: Relative keys share notes but have different root notes (C Major & A natural minor). Parallel keys share the same root note but have different notes (C Major & C natural minor). Modal interchange borrows chords from a parallel key while maintaining the same tonal center.
